entrypoints.summary: iOS custom URL-scheme dispatch for schemes registered in Info.plist, including ophttp, ophttps, onepassword4, onepassword, onepassword-help, and db-0bcm217bz8olcxj.

affected_components.role: Registers the custom schemes that form the competing-handler dispatch surface.

code_slices.fixed: No implemented replacement is supplied. The report recommends discontinuing the current deep-link implementation and exclusively deploying iOS Universal Links.
code_slices.surrounding_context: The report notes that iOS 7.9.6 had fewer schemes and that 1Password would reconsider Universal Links and their trade-offs in a future version.
code_slices.vulnerable: Info.plist declares CFBundleURLTypes/CFBundleURLSchemes, including the reported 1Password-related scheme strings.

preconditions: The victim has the affected 1Password iOS application installed.
An attacker-controlled iOS application capable of registering a matching custom URL handler is installed or run.
A URL using one of the affected custom schemes is invoked.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: A URL with one of the reported scheme prefixes, such as ophttp://, ophttps://, onepassword://, onepassword4://, onepassword-help://, or db-0bcm217bz8olcxj://.
trigger_steps.summary: Register a matching custom URL handler in a malicious iOS application, then cause a URL for an affected 1Password custom scheme to be invoked; the report describes possible interception by the malicious handler.

capabilities.concept: Competing application registration for a deep-link scheme
Interception of URLs intended for the legitimate deep-link receiver

impacts.concept: Credential phishing through a crafted login flow

mitigations.concept: Exclusive use of iOS Universal Links for deep links

impact.affected_asset: Information carried in 1Password-directed custom-scheme URLs and user credentials entered into a crafted login page.
impact.attacker_capability: An attacker controlling an installed malicious iOS application that registers a matching custom scheme may receive affected deep-link URLs and present a crafted login flow.
impact.security_effect: Potential interception of URL data intended for 1Password and phishing-mediated credential disclosure.

causal_trace.summary: The application registers multiple custom URL schemes through CFBundleURLTypes in Info.plist.
A malicious iOS application can register the same custom URL handler, so a 1Password-looking custom scheme does not reliably identify the intended receiver.

URLs using the registered custom schemes can be dispatched to and intercepted by the competing malicious handler; the report says this remains exploitable despite iOS first-come-first-served behavior.
The report describes potential theft of information intended for the legitimate app and credential phishing through crafted login pages forwarding credentials to attacker-controlled websites.

failure.operation: iOS custom URL-scheme handler dispatch to a competing application registration

primary_invariant.statement: A URL intended for the 1Password deep-link receiver must be delivered only to the intended 1Password application.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The configured custom-scheme namespace can be claimed by another installed iOS application, permitting a competing receiver to handle URLs addressed to those schemes.

raw_refs.role: canonical audit finding, configuration excerpt, and recommendation

quality.review_notes: The primary evidence is a public audit report containing the finding narrative, Info.plist registration excerpt, and mitigation recommendation. It does not include a standalone malicious app, runtime dispatch/interception trace, public target-source revision, patch diff, or test result. The 7.9.6 client-response note establishes that fewer schemes were present, but not that Universal Links were implemented or that interception was eliminated; impact therefore remains report-described potential.

remediation.invariant_restored: Deep-link routing should avoid relying on a custom scheme that an unrelated installed application can claim as the receiver identity.
mitigation_classes: replace custom URL-scheme deep links with iOS Universal Links
reduce exposure from registered custom schemes
